verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Memory MCP Server that lets users connect MCP clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to their Zep memory. Users sign in through Google Workspace or an enterprise IdP, and ABAC policies govern what Memory MCP users can reach. A probe confirms the dedicated docs page, and a separate (experimental) Graphiti MCP server also exists for the open-source graph. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Memory MCP Server works as documented.
